CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mir_core.support_staff(org uuid, member uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$
 select mir_core.staff_role(org,member) in('assistant','boss','admin','warehouse');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mir_core.support_allowed(org uuid, conversation uuid, member uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from mir_core.support_conversations c where c.organization_id=org and c.id=conversation and (c.customer_id=member or mir_core.support_staff(org,member)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mir_core.support_object_allowed(object_name text, writing boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core', 'storage'
AS $function$declare parts text[];org uuid;conversation uuid;owner uuid;begin parts:=storage.foldername(object_name);if cardinality(parts)<>4 then return false;end if;begin org:=parts[1]::uuid;conversation:=parts[2]::uuid;owner:=parts[3]::uuid;exception when others then return false;end;if writing and owner<>auth.uid() then return false;end if;return mir_core.support_allowed(org,conversation);end$function$
